# generated by `bb devtour` from docs/devtour/tour.edn — do not edit

Welcome. This is a guided read of the graphden codebase for someone who just joined and needs to find their feet in the whole system — not the user tutorial (that lives in ~docs/tutorial/~ and is about *using* the editor), but the host code that makes it run.

The system splits into a handful of relatively independent *blocks* (left). Read them roughly top-to-bottom: each block's ~after:~ line names what it assumes you have already seen. Start with the *Executor* — it is the spine everything else hangs off — then follow the dependency order: Storage, then Branches, Types, CRUD, Packages, Boot, Web, Layout, the Editor frontend, Services, Platform seams, Accounts, and last the Constellation — the six repos around this one. (The Platform block tours the in-repo seams and hardening; the multi-tenant / cloud POLICY layer itself is in the private graphden-tenancy repo — the open-core split — plugging into the ~graphden.tenancy.context~ seam kept here.)

Two blocks are worth knowing about before you need them. *Boot* answers 'what actually happens when the process starts', which is the fastest way to see how the other blocks are wired together — read it early if you are more comfortable starting from a running system than from a hot path. The *Editor frontend* block tours JavaScript rather than Clojure; it is baked and drift-checked exactly like the rest.

Every step shows you the *actual source* of one function, pulled straight from the file it lives in. When a step points you at code in another block, use the *see also* chips — *Back* always returns you along the path you actually walked.

Prefer to read in your editor? The same tour runs there: ~docs/devtour/devtour.el~ drives emacs against LIVE buffers — this prose in a side window, the real file open at the form — and ~docs/devtour/org/~ is the same tour as plain org files. Both are baked from the same source as this page; [[../../docs/devtour/README.md][docs/devtour/README.md]] has the setup, including the button below that opens the current form in your running emacs.

This tour is about the code, not the workflow. For how to BUILD and test it — ~bb ci~, the linters, the isolated worktrees and the serialized merge queue — read [[../../CLAUDE.md][CLAUDE.md]] and [[../../dev/wtq/AGENT.md][dev/wtq/AGENT.md]].

* Blocks

- [[file:executor.org][Executor — how a fn runs]] (22 · ~86 min) :: The spine: turn a graph 'description of a computation' into a value.
- [[file:storage.org][Storage & the graph]] (18 · ~62 min) :: How the graph is stored and traversed — Postgres, recursive CTEs, the StorageCRUD / ExecutionGraph protocols.
- [[file:versioning.org][Branches & versioning]] (23 · ~103 min) :: The VersionedStorage decorator, per-branch resolution, diff/merge and branch-local? propagation.
- [[file:types.org][Type system]] (17 · ~83 min) :: Subtyping, unification, narrowing, refinements, the sweep-at-zero checker, and the :secret information-flow marker.
- [[file:crud.org][CRUD & the write path]] (23 · ~67 min) :: Entity/branch/secret writes, request parsing, type-check on write, fn-execution lookup + persist.
- [[file:packages.org][Packages — the graph's content]] (31 · ~105 min) :: How fns.edn + impls.clj become base-fns and fn-defs; the loader, load order, and the first-party package tree — then the inverse: export, the ref wire form, and the publish/install registry.
- [[file:boot.org][Boot & lifecycle]] (12 · ~24 min) :: How the process starts: the Integrant component graph, the Aero config + addon manifest, and the router seams installed at boot.
- [[file:web.org][Web — routing & the page runtime]] (18 · ~27 min) :: HTTP from socket to response body: routing, middleware as graph fns, the hiccup page runtime, and the APIs the editor reads.
- [[file:layout.org][Layout — the editor's graph view]] (6 · ~22 min) :: Turn raw fn/slot/binding rows into the placed cards, edges and server-computed facts the editor renders.
- [[file:editor.org][Editor frontend — the browser half]] (15 · ~68 min) :: The ~25k lines of plain ES that draw the graph, bind the edits and mount the server's partials. No build step, no framework.
- [[file:services.org][Services & the fleet]] (19 · ~52 min) :: Desired-state service registry, the reconciler/supervisor, and the dynamic multi-executor fleet controller.
- [[file:platform.org][Platform seams & hardening]] (11 · ~28 min) :: The seams the multi-tenant addon plugs into (docs/TENANCY_SEAM.md) and the hardening layers the core itself carries — effect gate, SSRF egress guard, alerting, BYO executor.
- [[file:accounts.org][Accounts — the open identity module]] (5 · ~15 min) :: The opt-in identity layer (docs/ACCOUNTS.md): one account, many sign-in identities (password / Google / GitHub / Telegram), hashed sessions, email verification, TOTP 2FA, and the /auth/* + /login surface — all OFF unless the addon fragment is enabled.
- [[file:constellation.org][Constellation — the repos around the monorepo]] (8 · ~13 min) :: graphden is one of seven repositories, and the seams the other six plug into all live here: addon config fragments, the capability predicates, the external-package manifest, and a CI guard for the vars a private repo reaches. This block tours those seams and tells the other side of each — what graphden-cloud, graphden-tenancy, graphden-mathx, graphden-examples, graphden-internal and the org ~.github~ repo contribute, how they pin each other, and how a release moves through all of them.
